guard/31346.htm.text: Guard Sirius: Sigh... What do you want? Well, speak up or go away!

links.text: "Who is the lord of the manor and what is the tax rate?"

guard/31346-1.htm.text: Guard Sirius: Well, let's see.. My hometown is in ruins! And now, vicious beasts are trying to kill me every time I turn around... You'd be grumpy too! My hometown was a small, peaceful village in the manor ruled by the von Hellmann family. It was an humble village, inhabited by hunters and lumberj…

links.text: "Tell me more about the von Hellmann family."

guard/31346-2.htm.text: Guard Sirius: The von Hellmanns were aristocrats who ruled the manor in the eastern section of Rune. They gained power after their distinguished service in the war with Aden. But the revolt was their undoing! They were all brutally massacred! Now the mere mention of their name can be deadly... Watc…

guard/31346-3.htm.text: Guard Sirius: Yep, blood-sucking vampires, buddy! Have you heard about the one that looks like a beautiful woman? She seduces people and then sucks their blood!
